channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Imaaraadka, Qatar iyo Turkiga: Soomaaliya ma goob lool-lan saameyn, mise shacabka ayaa ka faa'iidaysanaya?
item.description: Falanqayn siyaasadeed oo gaar ah oo eegaysa xiriirrada Imaaraadka Carabta, Qatar iyo Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, iyo su'aasha ah: Soomaaliya ma goob lool-lan saameyn shisheeye, mise shacabka Soomaaliyeed ayaa dhab ahaan uga faa'iidaysanaya?

item.title: Crisis Group oo ugu baaqday dalalka Afrika inay xoojiyaan dadaalka xallinta xiisadda Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Hay'adda International Crisis Group ayaa warbixin ay Talaadadii soo saartay ugu baaqday dalalka muhiimka ah ee Afrika inay taageeradooda u xoojiyaan dadaallada Midowga Afrika ee lagu xallinayo xiisadda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Suudaan.

item.title: Saamiyada shirkadaha tiknoolajiyada oo sii hoos u dhacay iyadoo walaac laga qabo xilliga AI
item.description: Maalgashadayaasha adduunka ayaa Arbacada sii wadey iibinta saamiyada shirkadaha tiknoolajiyada, iyadoo walaac laga qabo in kororka sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) uu sii socon karo, inkastoo Jensen Huang uu dib ugu laabtay hoggaanka Nvidia.

item.title: AC Milan oo sagaal ciyaaryahan la'aan u ambabaxaysa Athens ka hor kulanka Olympiacos
item.description: AC Milan ayaa Khamiista Athens kula ciyaaraysa Olympiacos iyadoo sagaal ciyaaryahan ay maqan yihiin, kadib markii Davide Bartesaghi iyo Francesco Camarda ay ku biireen liiska dhaawacyada.

item.title: Mareykanka oo qorsheynaya canshuuro cusub oo Shiinaha iyo 14 dal oo kale ah
item.description: Maamulka Mareykanka ayaa diyaarinaya canshuur dheeraad ah oo boqolkiiba 20 ah oo la saarayo badeecadaha Shiinaha, iyo canshuuro cusub oo la saarayo 14 shuraako ganacsi oo ay ku jiraan Midowga Yurub, Japan, Kuuriyada Koonfureed iyo Hindiya.

item.title: Bayern oo bayaan ka soo saartay Musiala: calaamadaha suuxdinta waxaa markii ugu horreysay la baaray April 2025
item.description: Bayern Munich iyo wakaaladda 11WINS ee matasha Jamal Musiala ayaa Arbacada bayaan wadajir ah ku shaaciyay in ciyaaryahanka markii ugu horreysay lagu baaray calaamado suuxdin gaaban ah 22-kii April 2025, iyagoo sheegay in caafimaadkiisu yahay mudnaanta koowaad.

item.title: Guardiola oo sheegay inuu ka xishooday diidmada xulka Talyaaniga, tababarka xul qaran-na yahay tallaabadiisa xigta
item.description: Pep Guardiola ayaa markii ugu horreysay si faahfaahsan uga hadlay sababta uu u diiday dalab uu ku tababari lahaa xulka qaranka Talyaaniga, isagoo sheegay in tababarka xul qaran uu yahay tallaabadiisa xigta, balse aanu ku degdegin inuu dib ugu soo laabto shaqada.

item.title: Kenya: Guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC oo beeniyay in Gachagua loo ogolaaday inuu u tartamo madaxtooyada 2027
item.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Xuduudaha Kenya (IEBC) ayaa beeniyay warar sheegayay inuu u ogolaaday madaxweyne ku-xigeenkii hore Rigathi Gachagua inuu ka qayb galo doorashada madaxtooyada 2027, isagoo sheegay inaanu wax go'aan ah weli ka gaarin.

item.title: Jubbaland oo difaacday xiriirka Imaaraadka, kana soo horjeesatay baaqyada Xasan Sheekh ee xiriirka loogu jarayo
item.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka labaad ee Jubbaland, Mukhtaar Sheekh, ayaa kulan ka dhacay Kismaayo ku sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud aanu keligiis go'aamin karin xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, isagoo ka digay in xiriirkaas la jaro.

item.title: Xiriirka Xeegada Barafka ee Adduunka oo racfaan ka qaatay go'aanka CAS ee Ruushka dib loogu celinayo Koobka Adduunka
item.description: Xiriirka Xeegada Barafka ee Caalamiga ah (IIHF) ayaa sheegay inuu racfaan ka qaadanayo go'aanka Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ee Ruushka u oggolaaday inuu ka qayb galo Koobka Adduunka ee sannadka soo socda, isagoo arrinta u gudbinaya maxkamadda ugu sarreysa Switzerland.

item.title: Raheem Sterling oo xabsi ka badbaaday, waxaana lagu xukumay ganaax la hakiyay kadib gaari wadis khatar ah
item.description: Xiddigii hore ee xulka England Raheem Sterling ayaa Arbacada maxkamadda Basingstoke ku xukuntay 12 bilood oo xabsi ah oo la hakiyay muddo 18 bilood ah, kadib markii uu qirtay inuu si khatar ah u waday gaarigiisa isagoo neefsanaya gaaska loo yaqaan nitrous oxide.

item.title: Barcelona iyo Florentino Pérez oo heshiis la'aan ku kala tageen fadhiga dib-u-heshiisiinta kiiska Negreira
item.description: Fadhigii dib-u-heshiisiinta ee u dhexeeyay Barcelona iyo madaxweynaha Real Madrid Florentino Pérez, oo Arbacada ka dhacay maxkamadaha Madrid, ayaa ku dhammaaday heshiis la'aan, kadib markii uu socday ilaa toban daqiiqo oo keliya.

item.title: Hay'adda garsoorka France oo qirtay in Monaco laga duudsiiyay penalty kulankii Auxerre
item.description: Hay'adda garsoorka kubadda cagta France ayaa qirtay in penalty la siin lahaa Monaco kulankii Sabtidii ay 1-1 la gashay Auxerre, kadib markii Paris Brunner lagu riday gudaha goolka.

item.title: Watford oo Edward Iordanescu, tababarihii hore ee Romania, u magacaabatay tababaraha cusub
item.description: Kooxda Watford ee horyaalka Championship-ka England ayaa Arbacada shaacisay inay tababare cusub u magacawday Edward Iordanescu, oo hore u tababaray xulka qaranka Romania, kuna beddelay Alessio Dionisi oo Axaddii shaqada laga eryay.

item.title: Ffion Morgan oo u ciyaarta West Ham iyo xulka Wales oo dhaawac culus oo jilibka ah la soo gudboonaaday
item.description: Ciyaaryahanadda garabka ee West Ham iyo xulka haweenka Wales, Ffion Morgan, ayaa la soo gudboonaaday dhaawac ah jeexitaanka seedda jilibka (ACL), waxaana la filayaa inay ka maqnaato inta ka hartay xilli-ciyaareedka.

item.title: Lincoln City oo shaqada ka eryday tababarayaasha Chris Cohen iyo Tom Shaw kadib guuldarradii 4-0 ee Charlton
item.description: Kooxda Lincoln City ee horyaalka Championship-ka England ayaa Arbacada shaqada ka eryday tababarayaasheeda wadajirka ahaa Chris Cohen iyo Tom Shaw, lix bilood kadib markii ay si wadajir ah ula wareegeen kooxda.

item.title: EA Sports oo ciyaarta FC 27 ku dartay codka faallo-bixiyihii caanka ahaa John Motson oo lagu sameeyay AI
item.description: Shirkadda Electronic Arts ayaa shaacisay in ciyaarta fiidiyowga ee EA Sports FC 27 ay ku jiri doonto codka faallo-bixiyihii caanka ahaa ee kubadda cagta ee England, John Motson, oo dhintay 2023, kaas oo dib loo sameeyay iyadoo la adeegsanayo duubistiisii hore iyo sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI).

item.title: Colombia: Ciidamada ammaanka oo xoreeyay ilaa 20 qof oo 17 saacadood lagu haystay dukaan weyn oo ku yaal Cartagena
item.description: Ciidamada ammaanka ee Colombia ayaa xoreeyay ilaa 20 macmiil iyo shaqaale ah oo ku dhawaad 17 saacadood afduub loogu haystay dukaan weyn oo ku yaal magaalada Cartagena, kadib hawlgal ay fuliyeen ciidamo gaar ah iyo booliis.

item.title: Laba walaalo ah oo ku geeriyooday barkad biyood oo ku taalla koonfurta Hargeysa
item.description: Wiil iyo gabar walaalo ah ayaa ku hafteen barkad biyood oo ku taalla deegaanka Xadhig-xadhig ee koonfurta Hargeysa, sida ay sheegeen Ciidanka Dab-demiska iyo Samatabixinta Somaliland, oo xalay soo saaray maydadkooda.

item.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Kenya, Itoobiya iyo Uganda ku eedeeyay inay la shaqeeyaan Al-Shabaab
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), ayaa ku eedeeyay Kenya, Itoobiya iyo Uganda inay gacan-saar la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, eedeyn aan caddeyn lagu soo bandhigin.

item.title: CAS oo Morocco ku amartay inay bixiso inta badan kharashka dacwadda AFCON 2025, CAF-na ay sheegtay inay fulin doonto
item.description: Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ayaa Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Morocco ku amartay inuu bixiyo inta badan kharashka dacwadda horyaalka AFCON 2025, halka CAF ay sheegtay inay ixtiraamayso go'aanka isla markaana qaadi doonto tallaabooyinka lagu fulinayo.

item.title: Usman Khawaja oo sheegay inuu ka xun yahay 'weerarka shakhsiga ah' ee Pat Cummins
item.description: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee cricket-ka Australia Usman Khawaja ayaa sheegay inuu ka niyad jabay jawaabta shakhsiga ah ee kabtanka Test-ka Pat Cummins, kadib sheegashooyinka buuggiisa Sabr ee ku saabsan fadeexaddii 2018.

item.title: Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu soo riday drone Xuuti ah oo Ras Tanura loo diray, Mareykankana uu digniin soo saaray
item.description: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirka uu Arbacadda burburiyay 4 drone oo Xuutiyiintu u direen Ras Tanura, halka safaaradda Mareykanka ee Riyadh ay muwaadiniinteeda Bariga Dhexe ugu baaqday inay feejignaan dheeraad ah yeeshaan.

item.title: Arthur Rinderknech oo beeniyay inuu diiday baaritaan daroogo, kuna kalsoon inuu ka nadiifoobi doono
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Faransiiska Arthur Rinderknech, oo kaalinta 57aad ku jira adduunka, ayaa sheegay inuu filayo in laga nadiifiyo eedeyn ah inuu diiday baaritaan daroogo oo lama filaan ah, kiis ay baarayso hay'adda ITIA.

item.title: Indonesia: Ilaa 29 shaqaale ah oo ku xayiran macdan dahab oo daad qarqiyay
item.description: Kooxaha samatabixinta ee Indonesia ayaa Arbacadda raadinayay ilaa 29 shaqaale oo lagu qiyaasay inay ku xayiran yihiin macdan dahab oo aan sharci ahayn oo ku taalla degmada Bogor ee gobolka West Java, kadib markii webi buuxsamay uu qarqiyay.

item.title: Tartamada slalomka weyn ee haweenka ee Tremblant oo la joojiyay baraf yaraan awgeed
item.description: Tartamada slalomka weyn ee Koobka Adduunka ee haweenka oo toddobaadka soo socda ka dhici lahaa Tremblant ee dalka Kanada ayaa la joojiyay, sababtoo ah barafka goobta ma filna.

item.title: ONLF oo ka digtay soo saarista gaaska Kalub, kuna eedaysay Itoobiya inay dadka deegaanka ka reebtay
item.description: Garabka mucaaradka ah ee ONLF ee uu hoggaamiyo Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Maxamuud (Mahdi) ayaa Arbacadda digniin ka soo saaray soo saarista gaaska dabiiciga ah ee Deegaanka Soomaalida ee Itoobiya.

item.title: Mavericks oo Denver ku garaacay Nuggets 120-101, Cooper Flagg oo hoggaamiyay
item.description: Dallas Mavericks ayaa garoonka Denver ku garaacday Nuggets 120-101 kulan ka tirsan NBA Cup, iyadoo Cooper Flagg uu dhaliyay 24 dhibcood, 12 baas iyo 6 kubbadood oo soo boodday.

item.title: Shirkadda Malaysia Airlines oo iibsanaysa 10 diyaaradood oo Boeing 787 Dreamliner ah
item.description: Shirkadda hooyo ee Malaysia Airlines ayaa Arbacada ku dhawaaqday qorshe ay ku iibsanayso 10 diyaaradood oo Boeing 787 Dreamliner ah, iyadoo fursad u leh inay iibsato 6 kale.

item.title: Pittsburgh Steelers oo kaydka dhigay Aaron Rodgers, Mason Rudolph ayaa bilaabaya kulanka Broncos
item.description: Kooxda NFL ee Pittsburgh Steelers ayaa go'aansatay in Aaron Rodgers, oo 4 jeer ku guuleystay abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka ugu qiimaha badan NFL, aanu ciyaarin kulanka Jimcaha ee Denver Broncos, halkaasna Mason Rudolph ayaa ka bilaabanaya.
